about: C2a Home, folders, What's New (HA §10.2, §10.4; PLAN §1.7 default profile). Every rule and the supersedes are behind wp.c2a (inert until V2 accepts the package). Plates and mosaic bands are DOM attributes set by 41-home.js (data-lgs-plate, data-lgs-plate-id, data-lgs-plate-r, data-lgs-plate-tint, data-lgs-plate-occluder, data-lgs-mosaic: the four row bands, the open card and the name plate), not rules. Only the attended item pops, +15 mm, non-interactive; the card's Play and More hits are 80 px, so rule 2 admits +15. No pop while a section or page change animates (exclude .lgs-home-moving). Order matters (a later layer that overlaps a kept one is dropped): the card and the name plate come before the disc, and the disc of the card's own cell does not pop (it is hidden under the card, which morphed from it). R2 fix pass: the disc and the plate pop as circles / capsules (r capsule: Steam's 50 % radius read as 50 px gave a squircle over the round plate, sgcheck R1); the name plate takes no pointer events, so its rule skips the hit test (it was dropped as 'covered' by the cell under it); the card appears at +15 mm at once (fromMm 15), so the depth does not change while the disc morphs into it (HA §10.2). Legacy rules: 'tab-arrow' (Home's and the library's tab arrows at 4.43 mm, outside {0, 10, 15, 25}) is superseded while wp.c2a is on (C2c does the same behind wp.c2c; the rule serves only these two areas); 'tabs' pops the tab row wrapper's ::after, which What's New no longer draws (its track is on the tab row's ::before, 41-home.css A2), so it matches nothing here and stays for C1b's search; 'card' (the focused poster, store capsule or search result lifted 0.008 units = 2.95 mm, outside the allowed set; admission off, so it popped also on a stale .gpfocus in laser mode and wherever an area's own rule was dropped by admission) is superseded while wp.c2a is on: sgcheck on What's New failed R2 on it in laser mode and with a feed card focused (native session 19:50). It also served the library (C2c's library-poster rule replaces it behind wp.c2c) and search results (C1b): FYI REQs in C2a.md. What's New's feed cards (store capsules, recently completed, friends in game, carousel cards) pop by the steamhome-feed rule at +15 mm when attended (PLAN §1.7 content cards; rule 2 caps a small one).
